scope: strict N9 matching-carrier 3x3 HNF row1/row3 descriptor only
candidate_order: fixed bases plus exactly two released output-mark slots
legality_gate: ordinary untagged MM/YN target_token only; reapply fixed-line face_type; no capacity decoration
isomorphism_gate: coordinate swap on the 3x3 quotient maps row1 to row3
stop_rule: stop after exact saturation or a minimum-cut no-go; do not scan larger HNF orders
